# Elite Sunday Counseling

> Online psychological counseling led by Prabhleen Arora (M.A. Clinical Psychology, Ph.D. Candidate), available every Sunday, worldwide. Specializing in queer affirmative therapy, AI-affirmative therapy (healthy AI/digital-wellbeing use), and senior wellness counseling.

## Key facts
- Practitioner: Prabhleen Arora, Senior Psychologist
- Qualifications: M.A. Clinical Psychology (University Topper, Gold Medallist); Ph.D. Candidate in Psychology at Lovely Professional University
- Ph.D. research focus: Social support systems and cognitive distortions in LGBT populations
- Career clinical volume: 3,000+ individual counseling sessions; 40+ workshops reaching 2,500+ participants, across institutional (Lovely Professional University) and NGO (Sirat – The Cleft Warriors Ensemble) settings
- Current roles beyond Elite Sunday Counseling: Senior Psychologist at SynqSol, leading clinical validation of AI-generated psychological reports and psychometric test design; Psychologist at Sirat – The Cleft Warriors Ensemble
- Published research: "Personality Traits and Job Satisfaction among School Teachers", "Self-Confidence and Hardiness in Relation to Academic Achievement", "Internet Addiction", "Job Satisfaction and Quality of Life among School Teachers"
- Focus areas: LGBTQIA+ affirmative therapy, AI-affirmative therapy (healthy AI/digital-wellbeing use), senior (60+) wellness and companionship. Cleft/craniofacial community support also continues, via ongoing NGO work (see below).
- Availability: Sundays, 11:00-23:00 IST, open to all global time zones
- Session formats: Video, audio, and text-based (chat) counseling
- Languages: English, Hindi, Punjabi
- Starting price: Discovery session, ₹999 for 30 minutes
- Contact: info@elitesundaycounseling.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/prabhleen-arora/
